intent.description: Perform independent, scenario-based acceptance review of a released or release-candidate product across SaaS, internal tools, workflow products, and digital services. Use when a product contract is approved and real user paths, permissions, handoffs, recovery, evidence, and release blockers must be judged. Do not use for coding, redesign, unit-only testing, API-only testing, or acceptance while silently fixing defects.
